read.thesis: Costco Q1 FY26 comps 6.4% (7.1% ex-gas/FX) with 3.1% traffic; capex held at ~$6.5B and FY26 openings trimmed to 28 on Spain delays, while renewal rate slipped 10bp.

capex.quote: We estimate capital expenditure for the full year will be approximately $6.5 billion.

triggers.label: FY26 openings cut to 28
triggers.quote: revising our planned net new openings for fiscal year 2026 down to 28

triggers.label: Comp ex-gas/FX 7.1%
triggers.quote: Excluding gas sales entirely and adjusting for the impact of foreign exchange, comparable sales were 7.1%.

triggers.label: New warehouse productivity $192M
triggers.quote: With fiscal year 2025 openings generating an annualized $192 million per warehouse of sales in the year of opening

triggers.label: Core on core margin +30bp
triggers.quote: In terms of core margins on their own sales, our core on core margins were higher by 30 basis points.

triggers.label: Renewal rate down 10bp, may fall further
triggers.quote: we may still see a slight decline in the overall renewal rate over the next few quarters

guidance.quote: revising our planned net new openings for fiscal year 2026 down to 28
we continue to plan for 30 plus net openings per year in future years
We estimate capital expenditure for the full year will be approximately $6.5 billion.

red_flags.label: Renewal rate declining, may fall further
red_flags.quote: we may still see a slight decline in the overall renewal rate over the next few quarters

red_flags.label: Healthcare costs outpacing sales
red_flags.quote: This was perhaps the first quarter where we've seen health care costs grow at faster pace than our sales.

evasions.quote: we don't obviously get into talking about specifically our current quarter because we report our sales on a monthly basis
we generally don't provide sort of comments on forward looking what we would expect
